name: SQL: 1Z0-071 Oracle Database SQL (Oracle)
material_vintage: Oracle University 1Z0-071 Oracle Database SQL exam topics, fetched live on 2026-09-26 from the Oracle MyLearn exam page and itemised in full: every listed topic in the 16 areas is one item. Exam format as published: multiple choice; 63 questions; 120 minutes; passing score 63%. Oracle publishes no area weights and no past papers: every item here is original. Exam-dump sites were not used. Every query answer key was generated by running the SQL for real on Oracle AI Database Free (release 23.26) in SQL*Plus, each snippet as a fresh user loaded with the course schema.
level_source: standalone: a vendor certification with no RQF/FHEQ level

learner_notices.text: Answer keys come from a current Oracle release. The exam is written to hold across releases, so the course avoids features that only newer releases allow (selecting without FROM, GROUP BY on a column alias, the BOOLEAN type) and teaches the classic rules the exam tests.
Oracle also offers 1Z0-171 (Oracle AI Database SQL Associate). This course follows 1Z0-071, which remains live.
